subject: Pilot economics — burn scenarios, budget anchor & soft credit path
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@heliohealth.com>, procurement@heliohealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T15:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot economics — burn scenarios, budget anchor & soft credit path

Hi Emily / Helio team — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap and a couple of asks so we can size the pilot and put a credit path in place.

Key assumptions we captured on the call (please confirm or correct):
- Typical user request ~1,000 tokens in (prompt + system) with ~600 tokens generated back (avg response) -> ~1,600 tokens per interaction.
- Expected daily active calls at pilot peak: 20k–40k/day (you mentioned ~500–1,500 RPS-ish across peak hours; please confirm peak qps).
- Working pilot window: 30 days, integrating across two product teams (Search & Clinical Assist).

Burn scenarios (rough):
- Conservative: 0.5M tokens/day -> ~15M tokens/month
- Mid: 1.0M tokens/day -> ~30M tokens/month
- High: 1.5M tokens/day -> ~45M tokens/month

Unit economics (example baseline pricing):
- If unit cost = $900 per 1M tokens -> Mid scenario ~ $27k/month; High ~ $40.5k/month.
- If unit cost = $600 per 1M tokens (quantized / optimized path) -> Mid ~ $18k/month; High ~ $27k/month.

Helio comment today: target monthly budget range ~ $20k–$40k and a desired target cost of <= $600 / 1M tokens if possible.

Ask / next steps from your side:
1) Confirm expected peak qps and whether both teams will share a single API key or separate keys per product.
2) Confirm whether logs and usage exports need to be retained beyond 90 days (affects cost).
3) Does Procurement want a PO or will you use a credit-first trial (we can provide a trial credit + 30-day evaluation).

From Redwood — what we can offer now (subject to procurement):
- Soft trial credit: configurable; we typically start at $10k–15k for pilot windows of this size.
- Cost reduction levers we can run: batching, KV caching for repeated prompts, and a quantized model path — can often reduce marginal token cost by 20–35% depending on latency SLOs.

I attached a short usage-scenarios.xlsx that maps sample call profiles to monthly token totals. If you can confirm the qps and whether the two teams will be combined in usage reporting, we can turn around a recommended pilot credit and concrete per-1M token target.

Proposed immediate cadence:
- You confirm qps + retention + PO preference by EOD 8/6.
- We propose a short ops call on Mon 8/9 to finalize model variant and credit amount.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachment: usage-scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 sheets: per-team scenarios, token mapping, batching impact)
From: Emily Chen <emily@heliohealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com, cfo@heliohealth.com
Date: 2026-08-05T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot economics — burn scenarios, budget anchor & soft credit path

Alex — thanks for the recap and the spreadsheet. Quick clarifications from our side: we targeted a $25k/month practical cap for the pilot (this is our internal stretch; procurement will push for lower). We absolutely want the per-1M-token target to be <= $600 if we can meet latency requirements.

Confirmed items:
- Peak: on high days we see ~1.0M tokens/day across both teams, spikes to 1.4M for short windows.
- We prefer separate API keys per team so we can attribute spend and behavior.
- Logs: we need full export capability and 180-day retention for compliance — can you confirm whether Redwood supports that during pilot or if that's an add-on?

Procurement note: they asked if credits can be applied across multiple business units (yes/no) and whether we can get a short-term SOW/statement of work outlining the trial scope and objectives. Attaching their contact (procurement@heliohealth.com) so you can loop them in.

We can confirm PO vs credit model after we see your suggested credit amount.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Chen
Head of Product Data & Research | Helio Health
emily@heliohealth.com

On 2026-08-05 15:12, Alex Martinez wrote:
> Hi Emily / Helio team — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap and a couple of asks so we can size the pilot and put a credit path in place.
> ...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@heliohealth.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-06T09:15:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot economics — burn scenarios, budget anchor & soft credit path

Emily / Alex — appreciate the quick details. Based on the confirmed peak (~1.0–1.4M tokens/day) and the 180-day retention ask, here's what I can put on the table for a pilot that meets Helio's budget constraints while allowing us to gather quality signals: 

Credit / pricing proposal (initial):
- One-off trial credit: $12,000 for a 30-day pilot. Credits get applied across the Helio org but we will keep per-key attribution for reporting (so yes, multi-team coverage with separate keys).
- Goal: demonstrate a path to <= $600 / 1M tokens via batching + quantized variant. We'll architect the pilot to push repeated prompt caching and prefix caching where appropriate.

Model options (illustrative expected $/1M tokens before optimizations):
- high-cap/lowest-latency model: ~$1,100 per 1M tokens
- mid-tier (recommended for initial pilot): ~$700 per 1M tokens
- quantized / optimized path: ~$480–$620 per 1M tokens (depends on exact latency SLAs and sequence lengths)

If we combine the $12k credit with an optimization plan (30% reduction target), mid scenario (30M/mo) looks like:
- Baseline (mid, $700/1M): $21k/month -> after ops/quantization goal ~ $14.7k/month effective
- High (45M/mo) baseline $31.5k -> optimized ~ $22k/month

About retention: Redwood can enable 180-day export during a pilot — there is a small ops uplift for extended retention which I'll note in the SOW. I'll drop a short pilot SOW and the pilot-agreement-draft.pdf to your procurement contact today.

Next steps I propose:
1) Helio confirms acceptance of $12k credit + 30-day pilot by EOD 8/6.
2) We stand up two API keys and a minimal observability dashboard (token counts, latency, per-route cost).
3) Ops call Mon 8/9 to finalize model variant and hand off to engineering.

Attaching: pilot-agreement-draft.pdf (placeholder — will include credit application, SOW, retention notes).

— Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Enterprise | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-06T12:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot economics — burn scenarios, budget anchor & soft credit path

Emily — thanks, and good to see procurement looped in. Short confirmation from Redwood and immediate next steps: 

1) Credit: we’ll provision a $12,000 soft credit (applies org-wide but tracked per key) for a 30-day pilot. Credit will be applied automatically to usage over the pilot window; any overage will be billed to the PO/contract after the trial unless otherwise agreed.

2) Retention: we can enable 180-day export for the pilot; ops uplift fee is nominal and I’ve asked Ben to surface the amount in the SOW (Ben, please add by EOD).

3) Keys & telemetry: Alex will provision two API keys today (one per team) and provide a short integration checklist. Lauren will own the onboarding dashboard and send the invite to Helio (Lauren: please include instructions for token-level cost breakdown).

4) Ops call: confirm Mon 8/9 at 10:00am PT for model selection and engineering handoff. If that works for you, we’ll send the calendar invite now.

Please reply to confirm acceptance of $12k credit + 30-day pilot and that 8/9 10am PT works. If procurement prefers a PO first, we can accept a PO and hold credits until signing — but credits make the onboarding faster.

Thanks — excited to get Helio into a pilot.

— Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
